patch_description: Adds a third move type to the local search: when single-model moves and pairwise swaps both fail, try 3-cycle rotations among models on the two hottest GPUs (A→GPU2, B→GPU3, C→hot), which escapes local optima that 2-model moves cannot. Iterations capped at 20 with strict-improvement epsilon guard (1e-12) to guarantee termination.
